description: This Java class 'JsonSchemaBodyDecoder' handles decoding and converting request bodies (XML, form data) into JSON format, primarily for JSON schema matching in a mock server environment.

classes.name: JsonSchemaBodyDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding request bodies into JSON format, supporting XML and form data, for JSON schema validation.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Converts the request body to JSON format based on content type, handling XML and form data.

methods.name: splitParameters
methods.description: Splits form parameters based on specified parameter styles.

methods.name: xmlToMap
methods.description: Recursively converts an XML Node into a Map representation.

methods.name: toJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a collection or string value into a JsonNode.
